source_notes.wake: Legacy arrival profile: small behind heavy uses 6 NM at the threshold, rather than the 5 NM in-trail minimum. Constant-speed final approach simulation; not RECAT/CWT.
source_notes.radar: 3 NM conservative demonstration default; all modelled destination arrivals share one approach stream.
source_notes.parallel: Parallel arrival runways less than 2500 ft apart share wake constraints. This is not a complete parallel-approach or departure separation model.
source_notes.reserve: 121.639 domestic planning model: destination fuel + required alternate fuel + 45 minutes normal cruise. Final reserve remains protected from planned holding.
source_notes.weather: Assessed route clearance in miles plus closed arrival windows; not a live weather geometry model.
source_notes.crew: Operator-supplied remaining FDP and flight-time budgets; not a full Part 117 report-time/segments/rest/cumulative calculator.
source_notes.ground: 10-minute gate buffer, 40-minute minimum turnaround and 45-minute connection time are configurable simulation assumptions.
